title: Updating task_routes config during runtime does not have effect

## Minimally Reproducible Test Case

# Expected Behavior Updating task_routes during runtime is possible and has effect # Actual Behavior Updating `task_routes` during runtime does not have effect - the config is updated but the `router` in `send_task` seems to be reusing old configuration. ```python import celery c = celery.Celery(broker='redis://localhost:6379/0', backend='redis://localhost:6379/0') c.conf.update(task_routes={'task.create_pr': 'queue.betka'}) c.send_task('task.create_pr') print(c.conf.get('task_routes')) c.conf.update(task_routes={'task.create_pr': 'queue.ferdinand'}) c.send_task('task.create_pr') print(c.conf.get('task_routes')) ``` Output: ``` [root@shiny ~]# python3 repr.py {'task.create_pr': 'queue.betka'} {'task.create_pr': 'queue.ferdinand'} ``` So the configuration is updated but it seems the routes are still pointing to queue.betka, since both tasks are sent to queue.betka and queue.ferdinand didn't receive anything. ``` betka_1 | [2019-06-24
